headline: WGC Reports Steady Q3 Gold Demand Driven by Central Bank Purchases
summary: Overall gold demand remained steady in Q3 2026 despite record high prices, according to World Gold Council data. Central banks continued purchasing gold to diversify assets and manage risk.
why: The World Gold Council is an international market development organization for the gold industry. Central bank gold purchases are a key driver of physical gold demand and long-term price support.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Central bank demand provides ongoing fundamental support for physical gold prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
